rationale: The short thesis is intact and untriggered for invalidation: price remains well below session VWAP ($42.38), the bounce attempts are dying on light volume (1.6k–5k shares vs. the 53k distribution candle), and the macro tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.77%, sentiment -0.61) still favors the downside with the $38.89 unfilled gap as the target if $40.13 breaks.
